verse.text: Unless the LORD builds a house, the work of the builders is wasted. Unless the LORD protects a city, guarding it with sentries will do no good.

video.title: God's Soul Hack | Psalm 127:1–2 | Our Daily Bread Video Devotional

reflection: Every dad wants to build something lasting for his family, but this verse is a good gut-check: all the hustle, discipline, and planning in the world can't replace a home that's actually rooted in God. Practically, that might just mean starting the day with a quick prayer before the chaos hits, or admitting to your kids that you need God's help too, not just your own effort. Building a strong family isn't a solo project — it's you and God, working together.
